title: Tenth Circuit splits three ways over Fourth Corner's account
entities: Fourth Corner Credit Union; Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City; Tenth Circuit
summary: The Tenth Circuit issued a fractured judgment in the cannabis credit union's master-account suit — one judge saw statutory entitlement, one would allow a lawful-purpose amendment, one rejected relief. No binding majority established an unconditional right to an account. The first crack of the gate question that Custodia later answered. (Judicial Watch JM-08; the Judicial Watch carries the courthouse-anchored chart.)
source_label: Tenth Circuit — Fourth Corner opinion page

title: TNB's narrow-bank account suit dismissed as unripe
entities: TNB USA Inc.; Federal Reserve Bank of New York; S.D.N.Y.
summary: The narrow bank's suit over a delayed interest-bearing master account was dismissed because FRBNY had never issued a final denial. No right established, no denial reviewed — the gate question kicked down the road to Custodia. (Judicial Watch JM-09.)
source_label: TNB dismissal

title: Custodia sues over master-account delay
entities: Custodia Bank; Board of Governors; Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City; D. Wyo.
summary: The Wyoming special-purpose depository sues over its stalled master-account application — the case that will decide whether statutory eligibility is a right to central-bank money or an invitation the Reserve Banks may decline. (Judicial Watch JM-06.)
source_label: Tenth Circuit case page

title: Board adopts account-access guidelines
entities: Board of Governors; twelve Federal Reserve Banks
summary: The Board adopted final Guidelines for Evaluating Account and Services Requests. The guidelines establish a three-tier review framework for legally eligible institutions seeking Reserve Bank accounts and services. Individual Reserve Banks process account requests under the framework.
source_label: Federal Reserve Board — Guidelines for Evaluating Account and Services Requests

title: FedNow launches
entities: Federal Reserve Financial Services; Reserve Banks
summary: The Federal Reserve launched the FedNow Service for instant interbank clearing and settlement, operating continuously on a 24-hour, 365-day basis.
source_label: Federal Reserve Board — Federal Reserve announces FedNow Service is live

title: Banco San Juan sues to keep its master account
entities: Banco San Juan Internacional; Federal Reserve Bank of New York; Board of Governors; S.D.N.Y.
summary: The Puerto Rico bank asks a court to stop FRBNY from terminating its long-held master account — the other face of the gate: not who gets in, but who may be put out. (Judicial Watch JM-07.)
source_label: District preliminary-injunction opinion

title: Preliminary injunction denied in Banco San Juan
entities: S.D.N.Y.; Banco San Juan Internacional; Federal Reserve Bank of New York
summary: The court declines to stop the termination: contracts authorize it, the statutes preserve discretion, and FRBNY is not an APA agency on the theory advanced. The gate may close under the Bank's own risk process. (Judicial Watch JM-07.)
source_label: District opinion

title: SEC adopts Treasury central-clearing rules
entities: SEC; covered Treasury clearing agencies; Treasury-market participants
summary: The SEC adopted rules requiring covered clearing agencies to require their direct participants to submit specified cash Treasury and Treasury repo transactions for central clearing. Transactions with a central bank as counterparty are excluded from the definition of eligible secondary-market transactions.
source_label: SEC — Final rules on Treasury clearing

title: District court grants judgment for the Fed in Custodia
entities: D. Wyo.; Custodia Bank; Board of Governors; Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City
summary: Summary judgment for the Fed defendants: eligibility is not entitlement; the denial stands. The gate holds at the district level; the appeal carries the question to the Tenth Circuit. (Judicial Watch JM-06.)
source_label: Tenth Circuit opinion (procedural history)

title: New York Fed announces FedTrade Plus
entities: Federal Reserve Bank of New York; SOMA Desk
summary: The New York Fed announced that it would replace FedTrade with FedTrade Plus and move open-market operations to the new platform in phases. It identified repo and reverse repo as the first phase, followed by securities lending, Treasury outright operations, and agency mortgage-backed-securities operations. The announcement stated that mock auctions and small-value exercises would precede each transition.
source_label: New York Fed — Statement Regarding New FedTrade Platform

title: Presidential order addresses independent-agency supervision
entities: Executive Office of the President; independent regulatory agencies; Federal Reserve Board
summary: President Trump issued an executive order titled “Ensuring Accountability for All Agencies.” It directed independent regulatory agency chairs to consult with the Executive Office of the President and provided for White House review of certain regulatory actions. The order separately stated that it did not apply to the Federal Reserve's conduct of monetary policy but did apply to its supervision and regulation of financial institutions.
source_label: White House — Ensuring Accountability for All Agencies

title: SEC extends Treasury-clearing deadlines by one year
entities: SEC; Treasury clearing agencies; market participants
summary: The SEC extended compliance for eligible cash Treasury transactions to December 31, 2026, and eligible repo transactions to June 30, 2027.
source_label: SEC — Extension of Treasury-clearing compliance dates

title: HFSC Task Force hearing 1 — Examining Monetary Policy and Economic Opportunity
entities: House Financial Services Task Force on Monetary Policy
summary: Framing: establish the premise (Michel/Cato: 'the Federal Reserve is not an indispensable part of the economy').
source_label: The Castration of the Fed (vault synthesis; transcripts in 05 - Sources/Hearings/)

title: HFSC Task Force hearing 2 — U.S. Treasury Debt in the Monetary System
entities: House Financial Services Task Force on Monetary Policy
summary: Map the Fed–Treasury dependence; $52T of debt by 2035.
source_label: The Castration of the Fed (vault synthesis; transcripts in 05 - Sources/Hearings/)

title: HFSC Task Force hearing 3 — Examining Treasury Market Fragilities
entities: House Financial Services Task Force on Monetary Policy
summary: Establish the fragility that justifies the cure; tokenized Treasuries surface (Duffie).
source_label: The Castration of the Fed (vault synthesis; transcripts in 05 - Sources/Hearings/)

title: Supreme Court distinguishes the Federal Reserve from other independent agencies
entities: Supreme Court; executive branch; Federal Reserve
summary: In an order concerning removal protections at the National Labor Relations Board and Merit Systems Protection Board, the Supreme Court stated that the case did not implicate the constitutionality of for-cause protections at the Federal Reserve. The order described the Federal Reserve as a “uniquely structured, quasi-private entity” following a distinct historical tradition.
source_label: Supreme Court — Trump v. Wilcox order

title: GENIUS Act signed
entities: President; Congress; Treasury; federal banking regulators; state regulators; payment-stablecoin issuers
summary: The GENIUS Act became law, establishing a federal and state framework for permitted payment-stablecoin issuers, reserve assets, redemption, supervision, foreign issuers, and certification of state regulatory regimes. Its effective date is the earlier of 18 months after enactment or 120 days after primary federal regulators issue final implementing regulations.
source_label: Treasury — Statement on enactment

title: President purports to remove Governor Lisa Cook
entities: President; Board Governor Lisa Cook; Board of Governors
summary: President Trump sent Cook a letter purporting to remove her “for cause,” citing mortgage-related allegations and a stated lack of confidence in her integrity. Cook challenged the removal in federal court.
source_label: Supreme Court — Trump v. Cook, factual and procedural history

title: District court preliminarily blocks Cook’s removal
entities: U.S. District Court for the District of Columbia; Cook; President; Board
summary: The district court issued a preliminary injunction preventing Cook’s removal while litigation continued. The D.C. Circuit subsequently declined to stay the injunction.
source_label: Supreme Court — Trump v. Cook, procedural history

title: HFSC Task Force hearing 4 — 'Less Mandates. More Independence.'
entities: House Financial Services Task Force on Monetary Policy
summary: First cut: the single-mandate Price Stability Act strikes 'maximum employment' from 12 U.S.C. 225a.
source_label: The Castration of the Fed (vault synthesis; transcripts in 05 - Sources/Hearings/)

title: Logan proposes modernizing the FOMC operating target
entities: Federal Reserve Bank of Dallas; FOMC
summary: Dallas Fed President Lorie Logan proposed that the FOMC consider replacing the federal-funds rate as its operating target with a broader overnight Treasury repo rate, identifying the Tri-Party General Collateral Rate as a candidate.
source_label: Dallas Fed — The case for modernizing the FOMC’s operating target rate

title: Tenth Circuit affirms: no right to a master account
entities: Tenth Circuit; Custodia Bank; Board of Governors; Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City
summary: Published opinion: the statutes give Reserve Banks discretion to deny eligible institutions; §342 says the Banks “may” receive deposits, and risk discretion remains. Judge Tymkovich dissents. The strongest circuit law yet on the gate — eligibility is not entitlement. (Judicial Watch JM-06; courthouse chart in the Judicial Watch.)
source_label: Tenth Circuit opinion

title: Logan advocates centrally cleared Fed repo operations
entities: Federal Reserve Bank of Dallas; FOMC; New York Fed Desk
summary: Logan said central clearing of Federal Reserve operations could improve intermediation of Standing Repo Facility funds and align Fed operations with the private repo market's transition to central clearing.
source_label: Dallas Fed — Ample liquidity for a safe and efficient banking system

title: repo and reverse repo move to FedTrade Plus
entities: Federal Reserve Bank of New York; SOMA Desk
summary: The Desk began using FedTrade Plus for daily domestic repo and reverse-repo operations, including the Standing Repo Facility and Overnight Reverse Repo Facility. The cutover followed small-value tests in January and November 2025.
source_label: New York Fed — FedTrade Plus for repo and reverse repo

title: HFSC Task Force hearing 5 — Primary Dealers and Balance Sheet Constraints
entities: House Financial Services Task Force on Monetary Policy
summary: The replacement buyer surfaces: GENIUS-Act stablecoins now buy T-bills, $2–4T projected.
source_label: The Castration of the Fed (vault synthesis; transcripts in 05 - Sources/Hearings/)

title: FOMC and New York Fed change Standing Repo operations
entities: FOMC; Federal Reserve Bank of New York; SOMA Desk
summary: The FOMC announced the change on December 10. Effective December 11, the Desk removed the aggregate operational limit on Standing Repo operations and adopted a full-allotment format, with proposition limits applying by counterparty and eligible security type. The operations use FedTrade Plus and settle on BNY's tri-party repo platform.
source_label: New York Fed — Standing Repo Operations FAQ

title: Reserve Bank presidents reappointed for terms beginning in 2026
entities: Reserve Bank boards; Board of Governors; Reserve Bank presidents and first vice presidents
summary: Following reviews by Reserve Bank boards, the Board of Governors unanimously approved the reappointment of Reserve Bank presidents and first vice presidents for new five-year terms beginning March 1, 2026.
source_label: Federal Reserve Board — Reappointment announcement

title: Board requests information on a possible payment account
entities: Board of Governors; Reserve Banks; legally eligible financial institutions
summary: The Board approved the request for information on December 17 and published it in the Federal Register on December 23. It sought public input on a potential limited payment account for legally eligible institutions seeking direct access for clearing and settlement without the full features of a traditional Reserve Bank account.
source_label: Federal Reserve Board — weekly record of Board actions

title: HFSC Task Force hearing 6 — Striking the Right Balance Sheet
entities: House Financial Services Task Force on Monetary Policy
summary: Second cut: dismantle the floor system / interest-on-reserves; the 'attractive nuisance.'
source_label: The Castration of the Fed (vault synthesis; transcripts in 05 - Sources/Hearings/)

title: Schmid describes the Fed as decentralized and operational
entities: Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City; Federal Reserve System
summary: Kansas City Fed President Jeff Schmid described the twelve Reserve Banks as distinct regional banks embodying decentralized federalism. He distinguished monetary policy from “monetary operations,” including payment infrastructure and Treasury fiscal-agent work.
source_label: Kansas City Fed — The Economic Outlook and Monetary Policy

title: Supreme Court hears argument in Trump v. Cook
entities: Supreme Court; President; Cook; Board
summary: The Supreme Court heard argument on the government's application to stay the injunction preventing Cook’s removal.
source_label: Supreme Court docket — Trump v. Cook

title: Dallas hosts “Payments of the Future” symposium
entities: Federal Reserve Bank of Dallas; SMU; FDIC leadership; researchers and industry participants
summary: The symposium addressed stablecoin regulation, tokenization, smart contracts, financial privacy, electronic negotiable instruments, and access to digital payments.
source_label: Dallas Fed — Logan introduction at Payments of the Future

title: Warsh nominated as Fed Chair
entities: President; Kevin Warsh; Senate
summary: Kevin Warsh nominated to chair the Federal Reserve; seated by June 2026, hiring Paul Winfree (author of Project 2025's Fed chapter). The capture track of The Castration of the Fed.
source_label: The Castration of the Fed (vault synthesis)

title: Logan proposes a centrally cleared Standing Repo option
entities: Federal Reserve Bank of Dallas; FOMC; SOMA Desk
summary: Logan said the Fed should provide a centrally cleared option for Standing Repo operations to improve participation by leverage-constrained counterparties and align the facility with the Treasury market's transition.
source_label: Dallas Fed — Outlook for the economy and monetary policy

title: OCC proposes principal GENIUS Act regulations
entities: OCC; prospective federal and state payment-stablecoin issuers; foreign issuers
summary: The OCC issued a proposed rule addressing issuer activities, reserves, redemption, risk management, audits, supervision, custody, applications, foreign issuers, capital, and operational backstops under the GENIUS Act.
source_label: OCC Bulletin 2026-3

title: Bowman describes Kraken account as a pilot
entities: Vice Chair for Supervision Michelle Bowman; Kansas City Fed; Kraken
summary: At the American Bankers Association Washington Summit, Bowman described the Kraken limited account as a pilot for testing how certain nonbanks could access the Federal Reserve payment system.
source_label: ABA Banking Journal — Bowman on Kraken pilot

title: Kansas City Fed approves Kraken limited-purpose account
entities: Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City; Kraken Financial / Payward Financial
summary: The Kansas City Fed approved a one-year limited-purpose Reserve Bank account for Wyoming-chartered Kraken Financial. The bank classified Kraken as Tier 3 under the Board's Account Access Guidelines and imposed restrictions tailored to its business model and risk profile.
source_label: Kansas City Fed — Limited account approval

title: Treasury operations move to FedTrade Plus
entities: New York Fed SOMA Desk; Treasury
summary: The New York Fed announced on March 12 that, beginning March 16, the Desk would use FedTrade Plus for SOMA Treasury outright operations and for Treasury buyback operations conducted as Treasury's fiscal agent. The transition followed testing and small-value exercises.
source_label: New York Fed — FedTrade Plus for Treasury operations

title: HFSC Task Force hearing 7 — Revisiting the Treasury–Fed Accord
entities: House Financial Services Task Force on Monetary Policy
summary: The keystone: re-subordinate the Fed to Treasury; Lacker's five-point blueprint; English names Bessent.
source_label: The Castration of the Fed (vault synthesis; transcripts in 05 - Sources/Hearings/)

title: congressional inquiry challenges Kraken account process
entities: Members of Congress; Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City; Board of Governors
summary: A letter from House Financial Services Committee Ranking Member Maxine Waters asked Kansas City Fed President Jeff Schmid to explain the legal and policy basis for Kraken's limited-purpose account, the services it could use, overdraft and balance limits, added supervision and risk controls, and the extent of consultation with the Board, other Reserve Banks, and public officials. The letter noted that neither statute nor the Board's Account Access Guidelines named a “limited purpose account” and asked for a written response by April 10.
source_label: House Financial Services Committee Democrats — Waters letter and release

title: Dallas publishes balance-sheet reduction framework
entities: Federal Reserve Bank of Dallas; FOMC
summary: Logan and Sam Schulhofer-Wohl published a framework for reducing the Fed's balance sheet by reducing normal demand for Fed liabilities while preserving the ability to supply contingent liquidity during stress. The paper evaluates changes to reserves, currency, Treasury balances, repo facilities, discount-window operations, payment accounts, and payment technology.
source_label: Dallas Fed — Options for reducing the size of the Fed’s balance sheet

title: Treasury proposes stablecoin AML and sanctions rules
entities: Treasury; FinCEN; OFAC; payment-stablecoin issuers
summary: FinCEN and OFAC jointly proposed anti-money-laundering, counter-terrorist-financing, and sanctions-compliance program requirements for permitted payment-stablecoin issuers.
source_label: Treasury/OFAC — GENIUS Act proposed rule

title: Kansas City publishes stablecoin-use estimates
entities: Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City
summary: Kansas City Payments System Research published estimates concluding that stablecoins were used predominantly in crypto finance, that payments represented a small portion of use, and that bridging activity reflected limited interoperability among blockchain networks.
source_label: Kansas City Fed — What Are Stablecoins Used for Today?

title: Kraken discloses some limited-account terms
entities: Kraken Financial; Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City
summary: Kraken told Reuters that the account gave its Wyoming bank access to Fedwire and allowed limited overnight balances. Kraken said the account did not pay interest and did not provide access to the discount window, FedNow, or ACH. The firm did not state whether the account allowed Fed credit. A Kansas City Fed spokesperson said the bank was reviewing Waters's letter and declined further comment.
source_label: Reuters report republished by Kitco

title: Waller proposes further centralization of Reserve Bank operations
entities: Board Governor Christopher Waller; twelve Reserve Banks; Board
summary: Waller proposed organizing additional Reserve Bank functions as national lines of business, with selected Reserve Banks providing standardized services across the System. He distinguished functions requiring regional control from functions he argued could be consolidated or standardized.
source_label: Federal Reserve Board — Waller speech

title: securities lending moves to FedTrade Plus
entities: New York Fed SOMA Desk
summary: The Desk began using FedTrade Plus for securities-lending operations following testing and small-value exercises.
source_label: New York Fed — Securities Lending transition

title: HFSC Task Force hearing 8 — Derivatives' Role in the Treasury Market
entities: House Financial Services Task Force on Monetary Policy
summary: OFR being defunded; tokenization normalized; the collateral 'circularity.'
source_label: The Castration of the Fed (vault synthesis; transcripts in 05 - Sources/Hearings/)

title: Waller responds to regional-autonomy concerns
entities: Board Governor Waller; Reserve Banks
summary: Waller said his proposal had prompted claims that it conflicted with regionalism and Reserve Bank independence. He stated that monetary-policy participation, regional research, community functions, supervision, and discount-window operations should remain locally run, while other operational functions could be standardized or centralized under Reserve Bank control.
source_label: Federal Reserve Board — Waller on Reserve Bank operations

title: Second Circuit affirms FRBNY's power to close an account
entities: Second Circuit; Banco San Juan Internacional; Federal Reserve Bank of New York; Board of Governors
summary: Affirmed: the Federal Reserve Act does not compel a Reserve Bank to keep an account; contractual termination authority and statutory discretion remain. Second and Tenth Circuits now converge — the gate belongs to the Banks, in and out. (Judicial Watch JM-07.)
source_label: Second Circuit docket/opinion

title: Cleveland hosts program on central-bank independence
entities: Federal Reserve Bank of Cleveland; Board staff; academics
summary: The Cleveland Fed hosted “The Case for Central Bank Independence,” including discussion of accountability and the role of a decentralized central-bank system in promoting independence.
source_label: Cleveland Fed — The Case for Central Bank Independence

title: New York publishes SRF counterparty survey results
entities: New York Fed Markets Group; SOMA Manager; SRF counterparties
summary: New York Fed staff reported that counterparties identified the inability to net Federal Reserve Standing Repo transactions through a CCP as a material obstacle to facility use. The authors stated that central clearing was an area for further study.
source_label: New York Fed — Surveys Suggest Improved Willingness to Use Standing Repo Operations

title: SOMA Manager confirms staff evaluation of central clearing
entities: SOMA Manager Roberto Perli; New York Fed; Federal Reserve staff
summary: Perli stated that centrally clearing Standing Repo operations could improve participation, support a smaller SOMA portfolio, and align Desk operations with the changing repo market. He said Fed staff continued to evaluate central clearing and related alternatives, including CCP selection, membership models, and moral hazard.
source_label: New York Fed — Reserve Management and the SOMA

title: Board proposes Payment Accounts and requests Tier 3 pause
entities: Board; Reserve Banks; Tier 3 account applicants
summary: The Board proposed special-purpose Payment Accounts for eligible institutions to clear and settle payments without interest, discount-window access, or intraday credit. The Board affirmed that account decisions are made by Reserve Banks and encouraged Reserve Banks to pause Tier 3 account decisions while the proposal was under development.
source_label: Federal Reserve Board — Payment Account proposal

title: senator seeks records on Kraken approval
entities: Senator Lisa Blunt Rochester; Board Committee on Payments, Clearing, and Settlement; Kansas City Fed; Kraken
summary: Senator Lisa Blunt Rochester sent a letter to Board Governors Christopher Waller, Michael Barr, and Michelle Bowman and to Kansas City Fed President Jeff Schmid seeking information about the Kraken account, the legal basis and review process, safeguards, available services, and talks among the Board, Kansas City Fed, and other public bodies.
source_label: Senator Blunt Rochester — May 20 letter

title: Boston and New York hold third stablecoin/tokenization conference
entities: Federal Reserve Banks of Boston and New York; Board researchers; IMF; BIS; academics
summary: The conference covered stablecoin flows, FX spillovers, tokenized deposits, narrow banking, run risk, safe assets, and substitution between deposits and stablecoins.
source_label: Boston Fed — Third Conference on Stablecoins and Tokenization

title: Logan again proposes central clearing of open-market operations
entities: Dallas Fed; FOMC; New York Fed Desk
summary: At a Bank of Japan conference, Logan said the FOMC could promote market resilience and monetary-policy implementation by centrally clearing its open-market operations despite the Fed's exemption from the mandate.
source_label: Dallas Fed — Monetary policy and imbalances

title: Custodia cert deadline extended to July 11
entities: Supreme Court; Justice Gorsuch; Custodia Bank
summary: Justice Gorsuch grants Custodia an extension to petition for certiorari, moving the deadline to July 11, 2026. The one path left to reopen the account-entitlement question at the top. (Judicial Watch JM-06.)
source_label: Supreme Court extension docket

title: Schmid advocates regionalism in central banking
entities: Kansas City Fed; Federal Reserve System
summary: Schmid delivered a speech on the importance of regionalism in central banking, describing how regional information and Reserve Bank operations inform national policy and payment services.
source_label: Kansas City Fed — The Local and the Global in Monetary Policy

title: HFSC Task Force hearing 9 — Examining the Structure of the Federal Reserve System
entities: House Financial Services Task Force on Monetary Policy
summary: The body preserved and venerated while the demolition permits are read into the Q&A; 'Chair Walsh' confirms Warsh runs the Fed.
source_label: The Castration of the Fed (vault synthesis; transcripts in 05 - Sources/Hearings/)

title: New York tests agency MBS purchases on FedTrade Plus
entities: New York Fed SOMA Desk
summary: The Desk carried out a small-value agency mortgage-backed-securities purchase on FedTrade Plus to test operational readiness. As of July 10, the New York Fed's operating-policy archive did not show a full agency-MBS cutover notice.
source_label: New York Fed — Agency MBS small-value exercise

title: agencies propose customer-identification rules for stablecoin issuers
entities: Board; FDIC; NCUA; OCC; Treasury; payment-stablecoin issuers
summary: Five agencies proposed customer-identification requirements for payment-stablecoin issuers comparable to requirements applying to banks and credit unions. Comments are due 60 days after Federal Register publication.
source_label: Federal Reserve Board — Stablecoin customer-identification proposal

title: Supreme Court decides Trump v. Cook stay application
entities: Supreme Court; President; Cook; Board
summary: The Supreme Court denied the government's request to stay the injunction protecting Cook. The Court held that the government's legal position would effectively convert for-cause tenure into at-will employment; required notice and an opportunity to respond before removal; left the ultimate factual cause determination unresolved; and held that the Fed's removal protection is constitutionally consistent with a distinct historical tradition of independent central banking.
source_label: Supreme Court — Trump v. Cook

title: Supreme Court invalidates FTC removal protection
entities: Supreme Court; President; Federal Trade Commission
summary: On the same day as Cook, the Court ruled in Trump v. Slaughter that the FTC's for-cause removal provision violated the separation of powers.
source_label: Supreme Court — October Term 2025 opinions index

title: Logan proposes central clearing and blockchain-enabled collateral integration at New York Fed
entities: Dallas Fed; New York Fed; FOMC; SOMA Desk; private market participants
summary: At the New York Fed's workshop on market liquidity and functioning, Logan proposed that the FOMC voluntarily centrally clear its open-market operations. She also identified potential blockchain use to integrate market segments and accelerate collateral movement. The panel included SOMA Manager Roberto Perli, a Board economist, and a principal trading-firm executive.
source_label: Dallas Fed — Logan’s opening remarks

title: Fed announces outside leadership for five monetary-policy task forces
entities: Federal Reserve; Chair Kevin Warsh; outside task-force leaders
track_source: Policy framework / balance sheet / communications / data
summary: The Fed announced the leadership and objectives of five task forces reviewing balance-sheet policy, communications, inflation dynamics and framework, data, and productivity and jobs. The task-force leaders include former central-bank officials, economists, business executives, and technology investors.
source_label: Federal Reserve Board — Task-force leadership and objectives

title: Custodia's extended cert-petition deadline
entities: Supreme Court; Custodia Bank
summary: The extended deadline for Custodia's certiorari petition. If a petition lands, the Supreme Court may reopen whether statutory eligibility carries a right to a Reserve Bank account; if not, the Tenth Circuit's discretion rule stands as the law of the gate. (Judicial Watch JM-06.)
source_label: Supreme Court docket No. 25A1320

title: Payment Account comment period closes
entities: Board; Reserve Banks; account applicants; public commenters
summary: Comments on the Board's Payment Account proposal and related changes to the Payment System Risk Policy and Account Access Guidelines are due.
source_label: Federal Reserve Board — Proposal OP-1878

title: stablecoin customer-identification comments close
entities: federal banking regulators; Treasury; stablecoin issuers; public commenters
summary: The proposed rule was published in the Federal Register on June 22. Comments must be received by August 21.
source_label: Federal Register — Permitted Payment Stablecoin Issuer Customer Identification Program

title: Jackson Hole symposium
entities: Kansas City Fed; central bankers; policymakers; researchers; market participants
summary: The Kansas City Fed's 2026 symposium is titled “Financial Innovation: Implications for Payments and Policy.”
source_label: Kansas City Fed — Jackson Hole Economic Policy Symposium

title: cash Treasury central-clearing compliance
entities: SEC; Treasury clearing agencies; direct participants; covered counterparties
summary: Compliance with the trade-submission requirement begins for eligible cash Treasury transactions.
source_label: SEC — Treasury Clearing Implementation

title: outside GENIUS Act effective date
status: Scheduled by statute unless triggered earlier
entities: permitted payment-stablecoin issuers; federal and state regulators
summary: The Act becomes effective 18 months after enactment unless final regulations trigger the alternative effective date 120 days after their issuance.
source_label: OCC — GENIUS Act implementation summary

title: Kraken limited-purpose account initial term ends
status: Scheduled from announced one-year term; renewal or termination not announced
entities: Kansas City Fed; Kraken Financial
summary: The initial one-year term described in the Kansas City Fed's March 4, 2026 approval reaches its anniversary.
source_label: Kansas City Fed — Limited account approval

title: Treasury repo central-clearing compliance
entities: SEC; Treasury clearing agencies; direct participants; covered counterparties
summary: Compliance with the trade-submission requirement begins for eligible Treasury repo transactions.
